panels.note: The published panel: the shares, grades, and captions the guide ships.

panels.name: single-source
panels.note: One source falls below the explicit-source floor, so every race is insufficient and the races it did not cover have no share at all.

panels.name: two-sources

panels.name: district-sources
panels.note: District sources cover only their own races, so most races have no endorsing source and the rest have exactly one.
